fusions.name: Drape Swing
fusions.desc: Swings on a flung length of cloth to an enemy up to 7 tiles away and kicks it for 13 damage, up to 1.4 times as much at full reach.

fusions.name: Sack and Pound
fusions.desc: Throws a sack over the first enemy it meets, dealing 26 damage and turning it against its allies for 4 seconds. If it hits, every ally deals 15% more damage for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Troop Colours
fusions.desc: Waves a flag and bellows, drawing up to 5 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Knuckle Bindings
fusions.desc: Conjures cloth bindings around your fists: you attack 6% faster, your critical chance rises by 4%, your critical hits deal 20% more damage, and each kill returns 2 health.
